notes.title: Patch 1.31 - Minor Changes
notes.content:
Following the recent discord event and activity (Thanks again!) we have made a few minor changes, firstly we have added one new hat! (There is also a pirate hat wearing variant however the pirate hat is still only part of the support pack).

We've also bumped the player limit back up from 10 to its original 30 we will be keeping track of whether or not this causes any issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43910560/63ecee7266e5508c588f3a99f0e7bdea848c4976.png[/img]

While we can't give a definitive timeframe, there will be another update in the future, thanks for playing!

Here are a full list of changes:

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Restored multiplayer limit from 10 to 30
[*] Added new hat, and hat varient of this hat available in the hat pack
[/list]

- Bronze Box Team

notes.title: Patch 1.3! Bug Fixes and Spectator Mode!
notes.content:
Following the last update here is the spectating update! There are also various smaller fixes that have gone in this update.

We also intend to look into tweaking the balancing for the bomb gamemode following user feedback however I'm afraid this will have to come in a future update!

Here are a full list of changes:

[h2]Changes/Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to spectate for new gamemodes when you are out of a round, prompt has been added in game for this (Attack will cycle through players)
[*] Sound effects should no longer "stack" as badly in game when you are tabbed out and then play all at once when you tab back in.
[*] Shiney Scramble Gamemode item now has a marker when the item initially spawns instead of having to be found first.
[*] UI Interaction sounds are now consistent for all buttons
[*] Fixed issue where Colour picker lightness wouldn't reset correctly
[*] Fixed bug with Hat selector where it would trigger too many events
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V1.29
notes.content:
Thanks for your continued support and feedback, we are continuing to work on the game adding new game modes as well as tweaking and fixing bugs!

In this update there are 2 new gamemodes and a new hat for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43910560/107955236c69fcc2a8c68916a36e0f90f4835148.png[/img]

[b]Note:[/b] Currently when you are out of one of the new gamemodes you are unable to spectate, we will be addressing this in a future update.

Having said that here are the full patch notes for 1.29:



[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Smoothed values for stamina bar on clients where the update interval changes caused this to jitter. (This also applies to the host for consistency)
[*] Internal restructure of some gamemode code (this should make it a little bit easier to implement new gamemodes in future)
[*] Added gamemode BombGame where birds must pass the bomb to someone else before it goes off!
[*] Added Bird Brawl, a gamemode where you have one life and once knocked down you are out of the round!
[*] Added free new hat, it is now possible in the future for more complex hats and apparel to be added for birds to wear!
[*] Maps can now be selected in the host options in addition to the existing pause menu options
[*] Additional tool tips have been provided on how to choose gamemodes in the host options menu
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Outstanding issue with joining after certain gamemodes have ended causing errors and possible disconnects
[*] Fixed issue where when joining a server, players who are in the knocked down state upon joining appear standing up with the star effect around their head
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V1.284
notes.content:
[h3]Changes:[/h3]

[list]

notes.title: Patch V1.28
notes.content:
Once again thanks for all the constructive feedback we've had so far! Following this we have made some quality of life changes for the UI in terms of joining public servers and inviting friends.

We are looking into fixing other issues as well as planning some larger updates so stay tuned!

Full list of changes below.

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ping is now shown on servers in the server browser
[*] Ping is now shown in game both in the bottom right corner for each player and in the pause menu next to each players name plate
[*] Accepting invites from steam without having the game open will now correctly join you to that game once you have entered your birds name
[*] You can now access steams invite menu via the green pause menu button "+ Friends" next to the Players section.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.27
notes.content:
Thanks for all the feedback and reviews so far! 

We are diligently keeping track of any feedback and experiences people are having while playing Pigeon Protocol, and will be releasing several updates to improve stability and refine the game further so if you have any thoughts please feel free to share them with us!

We have decided to change the max players per server from 30 to 10 for stability reasons; we are looking into solutions to increase this number but for now we see this as the best action to avoid connection issues.

[b]Having said that here is the complete list of changes and fixes:[/b]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed max players from 30 to 10 for stability reasons
[*] Bird naming Adjustments
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Poop projectiles now move for clients as well as server where they didn't before
[*] Poop sounds should now be stopped for clients when projectiles dissapear
[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX V1.261
